frame._note: metres; origin = monitor position along the counter, on the counter's staff edge, at the floor; u = operator's right, v = toward the customer, z = up

TOP._src: 34 in AFF and 2'-6" POS top (REFERENCES_INDEX 6.4, High); u = half the distance to the neighbouring POS on the same run (rev7 pos_ft)

UNDER_SHELF._src: one open shelf, full counter width, mid height, no drawers, staff side (DEC-124, Nolan; overrides TI A940 det. 11 two-drawer cabinet); z = half the 34 in counter (REFERENCES_INDEX 6.4)
UNDER_SHELF.gap: GAP-RK-LAYOUT: exact shelf height and depth not measured (DEC-124; TI set has no under-counter section, CCTV CEN/EAST stills give no scale at that depth)

UNDER_SHELF_EDGE.gap: GAP-RK-LAYOUT: exact shelf height and depth not measured (DEC-124; TI set has no under-counter section, CCTV CEN/EAST stills give no scale at that depth)

STAND_RAIL._src: stand top 2.5 ft (REFERENCES_INDEX 2.2, Low-Med), edge of rev7 stand_rect facing the operator (the stand is on the operator's right, REFERENCES_INDEX 2.2). Hanging items: pos_m is the item's attach point (inside top of its hook) on this edge; yaw -90 puts the hook over the edge and the bottle on the operator side (spec RK-07)
STAND_RAIL.gap: GAP-REG-8: rail/edge section of the stand top not measured; hook throat sized for a <= 25 mm edge

STAND_EDGE._src: stand top 2.5 ft (REFERENCES_INDEX 2.2, Low-Med), edge of rev7 stand_rect facing the operator; draped items hang over it
